package_derivation.fixed_instance: d=5 Euclidean signature; scalar components (00;11) and (01;01)
package_derivation.scope: Exact reconstruction and completeness of two fixed scalar components. This finite-index replay is diagnostic and is not proof of the symbolic-dimension projector algebra or idempotence.

sources.citation: K. J. Barnes, Lagrangian Theory for the Second-Rank Tensor Field, J. Math. Phys. 6 (1965) 788-794, doi:10.1063/1.1704335.
sources.equation_scope: Projection conditions and the spin-2 decomposition in four dimensions; the package uses the explicit n-dimensional coefficient from Shapiro, not an inferred symbolic-d extension of Barnes.

sources.citation: I. L. Shapiro, The background information about perturbative quantum gravity, arXiv:2210.12319 (2022).
